domain: Healthcare Delivery & Health Economics (payment, claims and health plan analytics)

distractor_reasons.mba_pharmacy_rebate_statement_2025.csv: the 2025 pharmacy rebates credited to each employer's funding account; the assumptions memo keeps rebates out of claims, so retained claims are gross of them
distractor_reasons.midwest_employer_health_cost_survey_2025: a regional survey's 2025 claims cost per member per month by industry; the notice rests on each group's own experience, and no benchmark enters it
distractor_reasons.mba_group_roster_2026-10.csv: the groups' employers, industries and account managers; the notices are by group number and nothing on the roster changes a group's claims

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task479/generator); the administrator, the carrier, the employers, their members and the people are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the layouts follow common third-party administrator claims lag reports, eligibility files and specific stop-loss large claimant reports (12/15 contract basis), described in no shipped file beyond the pack's own dictionary
